plants.name: Nimbus Baloda Bazar Works
plants.notes: Newest kiln (2022); ships clinker to P08 (0.68 Mt) and P09 (0.60 Mt)

plants.name: Nimbus Mundra Grinding Unit
plants.notes: Gets 1.12 Mt clinker a year from P01 by rail

water.supply_note: Runs on desalinated seawater, so its own water supply is largely shielded from basin stress. It remains exposed through its clinker supplier.

flags.title: Coastal storm: current exposure
points: Kachchh district sees recurring severe cyclones every 4 to 10 years (IMD Climate Hazards and Vulnerability Atlas, as reported).
Cyclone Biparjoy, June 2023: landfall near Jakhau, about 100 km away. Mundra port operations were suspended and containers were blown into the sea.
WRI Aqueduct coastal flood risk: High (3 in 10,000 to 2 in 1,000).

plants.name: Nimbus Paradip Grinding Unit
plants.notes: Gets 0.68 Mt clinker a year from P06; blends fly ash from nearby power plants

flags.title: Coastal storm: current exposure
points: Jagatsinghpur district is classed 'very highly prone' to cyclones, one of 12 such districts in India (IMD classification).
1999 Super Cyclone made landfall near Paradip, with winds of 260 km/h and a 6 to 7 m storm surge.
WRI Aqueduct coastal flood risk: Medium-High (7 in 100,000 to 3 in 10,000).
